name: Takaoka Kouji
source:
One of [url=/c6813]Akihito's[/url] childhood friends. Although he may look like a delinquent, he actually cares a lot about his friends and can read atmosphere.

He likes anime and cute things. Has a habit of collecting cute characters/mascots.

[spoiler]Has a crush on Shizuku.[/spoiler]
